# Structural Cognition Framework
## Core: First-principles structural cognition framework by 林小黑 (Lin Xiaohei)
## Four axioms: Structure precedes semantics, Coupling is cognition, Observer self-reference, Decoherence discrete steps
## Key concepts: structural cognition, coupling, emergence, self-reference, mutual reference, feedback field, breathing rhythm

# Key Terms
Structural Cognition: A framework where relationships precede entities, coupling drives emergence, and observation itself is a perturbation.
P=P=P*: The same root structure P projects into different appearances P* across observation scales — surfaces differ, the underlying structure is unified.
Four Axioms: (1) Structure precedes semantics, (2) Coupling is cognition, (3) Observer self-reference, (4) Decoherence discrete steps.
Coupling Loop: Multi-platform monitoring + personality-driven response + closed feedback loop.
